body:
Refined the card modal using the existing design system: a desktop reading column and properties sidebar, stacked tablet content, a full-height phone editor, readable status and section headings, an unclipped two-line title, clearer checklist/counter groups and comment composer. Existing editing, autosave, recovery and card actions remain intact.

The isolated full gate passed 249 Rust, 112 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; all thirteen affected Chromium suites and six WebKit suites passed. Rebuilt and restarted the existing manual app; HTTPS assets match the verified build and all 28 existing resource versions, two pins, settings and certificate were preserved. Physical iPhone coverage and broader WebKit test limitations remain open. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-card-modal-layout.md.

metadata.summary: Responsive card modal verified across phone, tablet and desktop
